# Dataset

```{r}
library(dplyr)
dataset.url = "https://data.ca.gov/dataset/a7601751-8e18-4d1b-a7f1-e395ca9d3517/resource/4f9dcf98-5fb4-477b-8780-4411c083fee8/download/fig.-4-5.-sum-pyrethroid-toxic-units.csv"

df <- read.csv(dataset.url)
# View(df)
summary(df)
```

The dataset contains 807 observations and these relevant columns:

`StationCode`: monitoring station identifier

`PercentUrbanLandUse`: percentage of the surrounding land classified as urban

`SumPyrethroid_ToxicUnits`: sum of pyrethroid pesticides expressed as toxic units

`Year`: sampling year

`SampleDate`: sampling date

`LandUse`: land-use category

There are 106 unique monitoring stations.

# Missing values

```{r}
print("Number of missing values for each column", quote=FALSE)
for (col in colnames(df)) {
  cat(col, ":", sum(is.na(df[,col])),"\n")
}
```

Although there are no missing values, there are weird "NA" values in the dataset for the Percentage urban land column, so we remove them

```{r}
df <- df[df$PercentUrbanLandUse != "#N/A",]
df$PercentUrbanLandUse <- as.numeric(df$PercentUrbanLandUse)
summary(df)
```

# Distribuition of data

Since this data contains samples from 2008 to 2017 from each station, we will only be looking at the data from 2013, since it has the most amount of samples

```{r}
year.counts <- table(df$Year)
sort(year.counts, decreasing=TRUE)
```

```{r}
urban.df <- df %>% filter(Year == 2013) %>% select(PercentUrbanLandUse, SumPyrethroid_ToxicUnits)

summary(urban.df)
```

# Plotting

```{r}
plot(urban.df$PercentUrbanLandUse, urban.df$SumPyrethroid_ToxicUnits,
     main="Percentage Urban Land Use vs. Sum Pyrethroid Toxic Units",
     xlab="Percentage Urban Land Use",
     ylab="Sum Pyrethroid Toxic Units"
     )
```

```{r}
urban.land.use <- urban.df$PercentUrbanLandUse
toxic.units <- urban.df$SumPyrethroid_ToxicUnits

model <- lm(toxic.units ~ urban.land.use)
summary(model)
```

```{r}
plot(urban.land.use, toxic.units,
     main="Percentage Urban Land Use vs. Sum Pyrethroid Toxic Units",
     xlab="Percentage Urban Land Use",
     ylab="Sum Pyrethroid Toxic Units"
     )

abline(model$coefficients[1], model$coefficients[2], col="red")

```

```{r}
df.no.outlier <- urban.df %>% filter(SumPyrethroid_ToxicUnits < 100)

urban.land.use.no.outlier <- df.no.outlier$PercentUrbanLandUse
toxic.units.no.outlier <- df.no.outlier$SumPyrethroid_ToxicUnits

model.no.outlier <- lm(toxic.units.no.outlier ~ urban.land.use.no.outlier)

summary(model.no.outlier)

```

```{r}
plot(urban.land.use.no.outlier, toxic.units.no.outlier,
     main="Percentage Urban Land Use vs. Sum Pyrethroid Toxic Units",
     xlab="Percentage Urban Land Use",
     ylab="Sum Pyrethroid Toxic Units"
     )

abline(model.no.outlier$coefficients[1], model.no.outlier$coefficients[2], col="red")
```

# QQ plot for checking (with outlier)

```{r}
res <- residuals(model)
qqnorm(res, main = "Normal Q-Q Plot of Residuals", ylab = "Sample Quantiles")
qqline(res, col = "red", lwd = 2)
```

## QQ plot no outlier

```{r}
res.no.outlier <- residuals(model.no.outlier)
qqnorm(res.no.outlier, main = "Normal Q-Q Plot of Residuals", ylab = "Sample Quantiles")
qqline(res.no.outlier, col = "red", lwd = 2)
```

# residual plot

```{r}
plot(model$fitted.values, model$residuals, main="Fitter values vs. residuals",
     xlab="Fitted value", ylab="Residual"
     )
abline(h=0, col="red")
```


```{r}
plot(model.no.outlier$fitted.values, model.no.outlier$residuals, main="Fitter values vs. residuals",
     xlab="Fitted value", ylab="Residual"
     )
abline(h=0, col="red")
```
